_about: Scientists who use and support myGeeKy, shown on mygeeky.org as a network and a word map. Only people who asked to be shown (the 'Join the map' issue form, or an email to support@mygeeky.org) and whom the maker accepted. Each entry: name, role, place, link (https: ORCID, lab or personal page), fields (up to 6 short words), since (YYYY-MM). website/build.py checks every entry; text is shown as plain text.
